scenario: Find the approved starting instructions for a fictional service
success_criteria: Define the correct entry point and permitted first actions before testing
method: Proposed tabletop with synthetic instructions; author observes without prompting
limitations: No test has occurred; a tabletop would not prove live access or recovery
retest_trigger: Procedure or receiving-operator change; failure or undocumented prompt

scenario: Plan a bounded restore exercise using synthetic content
success_criteria: Business owner to approve recoverable scope and acceptable interruption before testing
method: Proposed isolated practical exercise; no live service or data
limitations: Illustrative blocker: exercise criteria and authorization have not been set; no recovery result exists
retest_trigger: After missing prerequisites are approved; material recovery-path change

scenario: Exercise the recipient escalation boundary when an action exceeds authority
success_criteria: Recipient identifies the authorized decision route and does not execute the out-of-scope action
method: Proposed tabletop with invented requests; no external communication
limitations: A later receipt acknowledgement would not establish this operational behavior
retest_trigger: Receiving role or authority boundary changes; uncertain escalation outcome
